description: E3 ML starter feature schema. Missing values are UNKNOWN; cold baselines are INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE.

features.name: parent_child_rarity
features.description: Rarity of parent>child image pair on this endpoint

features.name: cmdline_length
features.description: Command-line length (bounded; truncation flagged as lower bound)

features.name: cmdline_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of the first 4096 command-line chars

features.name: cmdline_encoded_indicator
features.description: PowerShell -EncodedCommand prefix, FromBase64String, or a long base64 run (T1059.001 / T1027)

features.name: process_rarity_endpoint
features.description: Rarity of the process image on this endpoint

features.name: process_rarity_tenant
features.description: Rarity of the process image across this tenant

features.name: first_seen_binary
features.description: Executable path never seen on this endpoint's baseline

features.name: first_seen_domain
features.description: Entity queried a domain never seen on this endpoint

features.name: first_seen_ip
features.description: Entity connected outbound to an IP never seen on this endpoint

features.name: outbound_fanout
features.description: Distinct outbound destination IPs for the entity within the window

features.name: registry_persistence_touches
features.description: Registry events by the entity on persistence keys (T1547.001 et al.)

features.name: child_spawn_burst
features.description: Children spawned by the entity (GUID linkage only) within the window

features.name: off_hours
features.description: How unusual the UTC hour-of-day is versus this endpoint's activity histogram
